title: Eltabbar’s Demonic Scenes
rows: A goristro slavers and roars while a hezrou chases panicking bystanders.
Two glabrezus chase passersby in a crowded square as an abveku (see appendix B ) pounces on bystanders.
A balor leaps from the top of a building onto a screaming crowd.
A marilith and two hezrous run across an empty bridge toward a crowd.

title: Thaymount Encounters
rows: A Death Knight directs four Hezrous to dig in the rocky soil of an ancient graveyard. The demons search for dead spellcasters who will animate once Szass Tam completes his ritual.
A Balor guarded by three Death Cultists tries to open a portal to the Abyss. Nearby are the corpses of a dozen Red Wizards who tried to stop them.
A Marilith and three Death Knight Aspirants hunt for vulnerable people to slaughter.
Two Goristros make their way west to attack mages’ fortresses nearby.
